name: PostgreSQL
what: A relational database with tables, SQL and transactions.
goodFor: anything you would reach for SQL to query

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development database with a small data volume

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application database with storage sized for its data

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan database replication, failure-domain placement, backups and tested recovery; none are established by this preset

needs: A storage class for the data volume
Under default-deny networking: apiserver egress, and node-sourced ingress on port 8000 for health probes

name: Dragonfly
what: An in-memory cache that speaks the Redis protocol.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development cache in memory

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application cache with memory sized for its working set

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan cache replication and failure-domain placement; persistence and recovery require separate configuration

name: MongoDB
what: A document database that stores JSON-like records instead of rows.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development document database with small data and log volumes

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application document database with storage sized for its data and logs

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan replica-set membership, quorum, failure-domain placement, backups and recovery

needs: A ServiceAccount, Role and RoleBinding named mongodb-database in the namespace — without them the pods never start
Two volumes per member (data and logs), so it costs two PVCs against the quota

name: S3 bucket
what: Object storage for files, addressed over the S3 API.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: 1 bucket

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: 1 bucket with a scoped user

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: 1 bucket with a scoped user

needs: An S3Instance for it to create the bucket in
Bucket names and access keys are global on the object store, so a tenant guard may require a prefix

name: RabbitMQ
what: A message broker that hands work between services.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development broker with a small data volume

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application broker with storage sized for queued messages

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan broker replication, queue durability, quorum and failure-domain placement

needs: For queues and users as manifests, the separate messaging-topology-operator

name: Redpanda
what: An event stream that speaks the Kafka protocol.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development event stream with a small data volume

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application event stream with storage sized for retention

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan broker count, topic replication, quorum and failure-domain placement

name: OpenSearch
what: A search engine and log store you query with full-text queries.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development search engine with a small data volume

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application search engine with storage sized for its indexes

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan node roles, shard replication, quorum, failure-domain placement and index recovery

needs: More memory than a small namespace quota allows; check the namespace headroom before choosing this

name: Elasticsearch
what: A search engine and log store, in the Elastic distribution.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development search engine with a small data volume

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application search engine with storage sized for its indexes

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan node roles, shard replication, quorum, failure-domain placement and index recovery

needs: Awareness of Elastic's licence tiers for anything beyond the basic features

name: EMQX
what: An MQTT broker for device and sensor messages.

presets.label: Dev
presets.summary: Development MQTT broker

presets.label: Small
presets.summary: Application MQTT broker with memory sized for connections and messages

presets.label: Resilience planning
presets.summary: Plan core and replicant roles, failure-domain placement, session durability and recovery
